# Geocodio

Geocodio provides straightforward and easy-to-use geocoding, reverse geocoding, and data matching services for US and Canadian addresses.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/geocodio/.

## Actions

- **Batch Reverse Geocode** (read-only): Batch reverse geocode up to 10,000 coordinates in one request.
- **Delete Geocodio List**: Delete a specific list.
- **Single Forward Geocode** (read-only): Forward geocode a single address.
- **Single Reverse Geocode** (read-only): Reverse geocode a single coordinate.
- **Append Canadian Provincial Electoral District**: Append Canadian provincial electoral district to geocode results.
- **Append Canadian StatCan Boundaries** (read-only): Append Canadian statistical boundaries from Statistics Canada.
- **Append Census Data to Geocoded Address** (read-only): Append Census block/tract FIPS and MSA/CSA codes to geocoded addresses.
- **Append Congressional District** (read-only): Append Congressional District information to a geocoded address.
- **Append FFIEC Fair Lending Data** (read-only): Append FFIEC (Fair Lending) data to a geocoded address.
- **Append School District** (read-only): Append School District information to a geocoded address.
- **Append State Legislative District** (read-only): Append state legislative district information to a geocoded address.
- **Append Timezone** (read-only): Append timezone information to geocode results.
- **Get Coordinates for Batch Reverse Geocode** (read-only): Provide a predefined set of latitude,longitude strings.
- **USPS ZIP+4 Append** (read-only): Append USPS ZIP+4 information to US addresses.
